newsitem.title: USA: Cent'l European Media adds D-mark junk bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Cent'l European Media adds D-mark junk bond issue.

text.p: Central European Media Enterprises Ltd has added a tranche denominated in German marks to its upcoming junk bond offering, market sources said.

The sources said the new offering will consist of a 100 million mark (roughly $54 million) tranche and a $100 million tranche of seven-year senior notes. The issue had previously been set at $125 million in straight U.S. dollars.

Price talk on the mark-denominated tranche is 300-325 basis points over seven-year German bunds, while talk on the dollar-denominated tranche is 300-325 basis points over seven-year U.S. Treasuries, sources said.
The notes have been rated B1/B-plus.
Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co, the lead underwriter, was expected to price the deal on Thursday.
